note: Export side is factually confirmed: dated customs/B-L records with HS codes, destinations (Italy, Germany, Brazil) and BOL numbers, all ex BANGALORE ICD, latest 2026-02-28. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders and annual-report revenue splits are therefore null — not public in the sources reachable in this session, not invented. Note the ImportKey page also lists a related entity KEMS AUTO COMPONENTS LIMITED at the same Bangalore address (No.100/52, 2nd Floor, Donna Bas Towers, Railway Parallel Road), so some aggregated records may belong to the group rather than to KEMS FORGINGS LIMITED alone. No rejection grounds: legal entity appears active with ongoing 2026 shipments.
